name: A Country Within Myself (monthly essay series)

mentions.name: A Country Within Myself (monthly essay series)
mentions.description: This is a monthly essay-writing and publishing project; the sixth installment, "A Country Within Myself," is a personal travel essay about hiking Fuego Volcano in Guatemala with the author's wife for their 20th anniversary.
mentions.source_excerpt: Six months ago I began writing and publishing one essay a month. Last month my wife and I hiked Fuego Volcano in Guatamela for our 20th anniversary. Here is my essay on that: A Country Within Myself - https://www.metanoia-research.com/dispatch-005-a-country-within-myself/ .
